preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 10
preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin.split() if line.isdigit() and int(line) <= 10**5])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line is an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5) representing the number of colors.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(num) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.split() if not line.isdigit() or int(line) > 10**5 for num in line.split() if num.isdigit())
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains N space-separated integers A_i (1 ≤ A_i ≤ 10^9) representing the initial colors.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.split()) == T for stdout in [line.strip() for line in stdin.split() if line.strip()])
postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.split()[i] == str(min_operations) for i, stdout in enumerate([line.strip() for line in stdin.split() if line.strip()]) if i < T)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line must be a single integer representing the minimum number of mixing operations required to make all colors pairwise distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(min_operations >= 0 for min_operations in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.split() if line.strip()])
postconditions.description: The minimum number of operations is always a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(A)) == N for A in [[int(num) for num in line.split()[1:]] for line in stdin.split() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) > 1])
postconditions.description: If all colors are already pairwise distinct, the minimum number of operations is 0.

postconditions.expression: all(min_operations == (N - len(set(A))) for A in [[int(num) for num in line.split()[1:]] for line in stdin.split() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) > 1] for min_operations in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.split() if line.strip()])
postconditions.description: The minimum number of operations is equal to the number of duplicates in the initial colors (N - number of unique colors).
